nodes.label: HERB mapping key — per-dataset declarative settings (content / directories+kind / id_spaces).
nodes.norm_label: herb mapping key — per-dataset declarative settings (content / directories+kind / id_spaces).

nodes.label: The key declares only the three judgments shape cannot recover (content, directories+kind, id_spaces); everything unmentioned mirrors automatically and silence means mirror it.
nodes.norm_label: the key declares only the three judgments shape cannot recover (content, directories+kind, id_spaces); everything unmentioned mirrors automatically and silence means mirror it.

nodes.label: A source (file) name here IS a product (PitchForce, ContentForce, …); sources.kind=product feeds the interpreter-flag→scope join under the universal person|org|product enum.
nodes.norm_label: a source (file) name here is a product (pitchforce, contentforce, ...); sources.kind=product feeds the interpreter-flag→scope join under the universal person|org|product enum.

nodes.label: content declares the JSON-pointer leaves into products/*.json that get chunked and tagged (slack message text, PR summaries/review comments, document content+feedback, meeting transcripts, meeting chats, url descriptions).
nodes.norm_label: content declares the json-pointer leaves into products/*.json that get chunked and tagged (slack message text, pr summaries/review comments, document content+feedback, meeting transcripts, meeting chats, url descriptions).

nodes.label: directories declare id-directories resolved through raw never mirrored: employee (kind person, key employee_id) and customer (kind person, key CUST-id), each with a file/key/name; pr_author is a directory-less person population (EMP_ logins, exact-match only).
nodes.norm_label: directories declare id-directories resolved through raw never mirrored: employee (kind person, key employee_id) and customer (kind person, key cust-id), each with a file/key/name; pr_author is a directory-less person population (emp_ logins, exact-match only).

nodes.label: id_spaces assign which fields carry which id-space (employee: slack userId, document author, transcript participants; pr_author: PR + review user.login), becoming id-set attributes at record→covering-chunk or file→File-node scope.
nodes.norm_label: id_spaces assign which fields carry which id-space (employee: slack userid, document author, transcript participants; pr_author: pr + review user.login), becoming id-set attributes at record→covering-chunk or file→file-node scope.

nodes.label: The eval oracle is not declared here: /team/* and /customers/* are oracle-only per the dataset card, so derive_corpus strips them structurally and the scanned corpus view physically cannot contain the oracle; the customer directory stays because customer names in artifact text still resolve against it.
nodes.norm_label: the eval oracle is not declared here: /team/* and /customers/* are oracle-only per the dataset card, so derive_corpus strips them structurally and the scanned corpus view physically cannot contain the oracle; the customer directory stays because customer names in artifact text still resolve against it.

nodes.label: Unresolved-ref policy: a value in an id-space field resolving to no directory entry (e.g. 2/56 slack userIds) is flagged loudly at build time, never silently dropped or invented.
nodes.norm_label: unresolved-ref policy: a value in an id-space field resolving to no directory entry (e.g. 2/56 slack userids) is flagged loudly at build time, never silently dropped or invented.
